starting-out-boarding-raft-before-starti.text: You're not sure if the raft is safe to use. Best to leave it alone.

starting-out-talking-to-hudon-while-stan.text: Hudon can't hear you because of the noise of the waterfall. Perhaps the acoustics would be better from that island?

starting-out-talking-to-almera.speaker: Almera
starting-out-talking-to-almera.text: Ah, hello there. Nice to see an outsider for a change. Are you busy? I have a problem.
With a combat level lower than 25:

steps.text: Before starting this quest, be aware that your combat level is lower than the recommended level of 25.

steps.speaker: Almera
steps.text: It's my son Hudon, he's always getting into trouble. The boy's convinced there's hidden treasure in the river and I'm a bit worried about his safety, the poor lad can't even swim.

steps.player: I could go and take a look for you if you like?

steps.speaker: Almera
steps.text: Would you? You are kind. You can use the small raft out back if you wish, do be careful, the current down stream is very strong.

steps.player: I'm afraid I'm in a rush.

steps.speaker: Almera
steps.text: Oh okay, never mind.

starting-out-talking-to-almera-talking-t.speaker: Almera
starting-out-talking-to-almera-talking-t.text: Hello brave adventurer, have you seen my boy yet?

starting-out-talking-to-almera-talking-t.player: I'm afraid not, but I'm sure he hasn't gone far.

starting-out-talking-to-almera-talking-t.speaker: Almera
starting-out-talking-to-almera-talking-t.text: I do hope so, you can't be too careful these days.

starting-out-talking-to-almera-talking-t.player: Have you seen a small boy?

starting-out-talking-to-almera-talking-t.speaker: Gerald
starting-out-talking-to-almera-talking-t.text: Nope, plenty of small fish though.

starting-out-using-the-raft.text: You board the small raft and push off down stream...

starting-out-using-the-raft.player: Hello son, are you okay? You need help?

starting-out-using-the-raft.speaker: Hudon
starting-out-using-the-raft.text: It looks like you need the help.

starting-out-using-the-raft.player: Your mum sent me to find you.

starting-out-using-the-raft.speaker: Hudon
starting-out-using-the-raft.text: Don't play nice with me, I know you're looking for the treasure too.

starting-out-using-the-raft.player: Where is this treasure you talk of?

starting-out-using-the-raft.speaker: Hudon
starting-out-using-the-raft.text: Just because I'm small doesn't mean I'm dumb! If I told you, you would take it all for yourself.

starting-out-using-the-raft.player: Hmm... I wonder what this treasure is.

starting-out-talking-to-hudon-again.speaker: Hudon
starting-out-talking-to-hudon-again.text: I'll find that treasure soon, just you wait and see.

starting-out-swimming-to-the-rock.text: You swim out into the water...
...but the current is too strong, washing you downstream.

starting-out-getting-washed-down-the-wat.speaker: Gerald
starting-out-getting-washed-down-the-wat.text: Blimey! Where did you come from? Not another one of those treasure hunters are you?

starting-out-getting-washed-down-the-wat.speaker: Gerald
starting-out-getting-washed-down-the-wat.text: They say there's treasure hidden within the waterfall, left behind by the old elven king. Not that anyone's ever found anything.

starting-out-getting-washed-down-the-wat.player: Interesting, is there somewhere I can learn more about this?

starting-out-getting-washed-down-the-wat.speaker: Gerald
starting-out-getting-washed-down-the-wat.text: You could ask Hadley the tourist guide. He'll be in this building just here.

starting-out-talking-to-almera-after-tal.speaker: Almera
starting-out-talking-to-almera-after-tal.text: Well hello, you're still around then.

starting-out-talking-to-almera-after-tal.player: I saw Hudon by the river but he refused to come back with me.

starting-out-talking-to-almera-after-tal.speaker: Almera
starting-out-talking-to-almera-after-tal.text: Yes he told me, the foolish lad came in drenched to the bone, he had fallen into the waterfall, lucky he wasn't killed! Now he can spend the rest of the summer in his room.

starting-out-talking-to-almera-after-tal.player: Any ideas what I could do while I'm here?

starting-out-talking-to-almera-after-tal.speaker: Almera
starting-out-talking-to-almera-after-tal.text: Why don't you visit the tourist centre south of the waterfall?

starting-out-talking-to-gerald-again-bef.speaker: Gerald
starting-out-talking-to-gerald-again-bef.text: Hello traveller. Are you here to fish or to hunt for treasure?

starting-out-talking-to-gerald-again-bef.speaker: Gerald
starting-out-talking-to-gerald-again-bef.text: Adventurers pass through here every week, they never find anything though.

starting-out-talking-to-gerald-again-bef.player: What treasure are they looking for?

starting-out-talking-to-gerald-again-bef.speaker: Gerald
starting-out-talking-to-gerald-again-bef.text: They say there's treasure hidden within the waterfall, left behind by the old elven king. Not that anyone's ever found anything.

starting-out-talking-to-gerald-again-bef.player: Interesting, is there somewhere I can learn more about this?

starting-out-talking-to-gerald-again-bef.speaker: Gerald
starting-out-talking-to-gerald-again-bef.text: You could ask Hadley the tourist guide. He'll be in this building just here.

starting-out-talking-to-hadley.text: If the player doesn't have the Book on Baxtorian in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Hadley
steps.text: Are you on holiday? If so you've come to the right place. I'm Hadley the tourist guide, anything you need to know just ask me. We have some of the most unspoilt wildlife and scenery in Gielinor.

steps.speaker: Hadley
steps.text: People come from miles around to fish in the clear lakes or to wander the beautiful hillsides.

steps.speaker: Hadley
steps.text: Surely pretty is an understatement, [sir./lady./.] Beautiful, amazing or possibly life-changing would be more suitable wording. Have you seen Baxtorian Falls? Named after the elven king who was buried beneath them.

starting-out-talking-to-hadley.text: If the player has the Book on Baxtorian in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Hadley
steps.text: I hope you're enjoying your stay, there should be lots of useful infomation in that book you've got. Make sure you give it a read.

options.text: Can you tell me what happened to the elven king?

steps.player: Can you tell me what happened to the elven king?

steps.speaker: Hadley
steps.text: Baxtorian? I guess he died a long long time ago, it's quite sad really. After leaving his kingdom to deal with invading forces, Baxtorian returned to find his wife Glarial had been captured by the enemy.

steps.speaker: Hadley
steps.text: This destroyed Baxtorian, after years of searching he became a recluse. He went into the secret home he had made for Glarial under the waterfall and sealed himself in. To this day, no one has managed to enter.

steps.speaker: Hadley
steps.text: Anyway, I believe we have a book on him upstairs if you want to learn more.

options.text: Where else is worth visiting around here?

steps.player: Where else is worth visiting around here?

steps.speaker: Hadley
steps.text: There is a lovely spot for a picnic on the hill to the north east, there's a monument to the elven queen Glarial. It really is quite pretty.

steps.speaker: Hadley
steps.text: Baxtorian's wife, the only other person who could also enter the waterfall apart from him. She was queen when this land was inhabited by elven kind.

steps.speaker: Hadley
steps.text: Glarial was kidnapped while Baxtorian was away, but they eventually recovered her body and brought her home to rest.

steps.speaker: Hadley
steps.text: True, I believe we have a book on Baxtorian and Glarial upstairs if you want to learn more.

options.text: Is there treasure under the waterfall?

steps.player: Is there treasure under the waterfall?

steps.speaker: Hadley
steps.text: Ha ha... Another treasure hunter. Well if there is no one's been able to get to it. They've been searching that river for decades, all to no avail.

steps.speaker: Hadley
steps.text: Enjoy your visit.

starting-out-searching-the-correct-bookc.text: If the player does not have the book:

steps.text: You find a book named 'Book on Baxtorian' on the bookcase.

starting-out-searching-the-correct-bookc.text: If the player already has the book:

steps.text: You search the bookcase but find nothing of interest
You don't find anything that you'd ever want to read.
You find nothing to interest you.
None of them look very interesting

starting-out-talking-to-almera-after-rea.speaker: Almera
starting-out-talking-to-almera-after-rea.text: Well hello again brave adventurer, are you enjoying the tranquil scenery of these parts?

starting-out-talking-to-almera-after-rea.speaker: Almera
starting-out-talking-to-almera-after-rea.text: Well I'm glad to hear it The authorities wanted to dig up this whole area for a mine, but the few locals who lived here wouldn't budge and they gave up.

starting-out-talking-to-hudon-after-read.speaker: Hudon
starting-out-talking-to-hudon-after-read.text: Oh it's you, trying to find my treasure again are you?

starting-out-talking-to-hudon-after-read.player: I didn't know it belonged to you.

starting-out-talking-to-hudon-after-read.speaker: Hudon
starting-out-talking-to-hudon-after-read.text: It will do when I find it. I just need to get into this blasted waterfall I've been washed downstream three times already.

obtaining-the-pebble-opening-door-to-gol.text: If the player doesn't have the key:

steps.speaker: Golrie
steps.text: Oh, don't worry, I'm totally fine. I locked myself in here for protection, but I've left the key somewhere.

steps.player: Okay... I'll have a look for a key.

obtaining-the-pebble-opening-door-to-gol.text: If the player has the key:

steps.text: You use the key to unlock the gate.

obtaining-the-pebble-opening-door-to-gol.text: You open the gate and walk through.

obtaining-the-pebble-searching-the-crate.text: If the player doesn't have the key:

steps.text: You find a key in the crate.

obtaining-the-pebble-searching-the-crate.text: If the player has the key:

steps.text: You search the crate but find nothing of interest.

obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-golrie.player: Who are you, and what are you doing here?

obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-golrie.speaker: Golrie
obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-golrie.text: I'm Golrie, and this is my home. Thing is, as you can see, I've got a small problem. Those hob-gobs are all over the place trying to steal my family's heirlooms. I've been stuck here for ages!

obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-golrie.speaker: Golrie
obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-golrie.text: Oh don't worry, I'm sure I'll work something out. I just need some time to think.

obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-golrie.player: In that case, do you mind if I have a look around?

obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-golrie.text: You look amongst the junk on the floor and find Glarial's pebble.

obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-golrie.player: Could I take this old pebble?

obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-golrie.speaker: Golrie
obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-golrie.text: Oh that. Yes, have it. It's just some old elven junk I believe.

obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-golrie.speaker: Golrie
obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-golrie.text: Ah, thanks a lot for the key, traveller.

obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-golrie-t.player: Do you mind if I have another look through this stuff?

obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-golrie-t.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You look amongst the junk on the floor and find Glarial's pebble but you don't have enough room to take it.

obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-golrie-t.text: You look amongst the junk on the floor and find Glarial's pebble.

obtaining-the-pebble-using-glarial-s-peb.text: If the player has disallowed items:

steps.text: You place the pebble in the gravestone's small indent but nothing happens.

obtaining-the-pebble-using-glarial-s-peb.text: If the player has no disallowed items:

steps.text: You place the pebble in the gravestone's small indent. The stone slab slides back revealing a ladder. You climb down it.

obtaining-the-pebble-searching-the-chest.text: If the player does not have Glarial's amulet:

steps.text: You find a small amulet in the chest.

obtaining-the-pebble-searching-the-chest.text: If the player already has Glarial's amulet:

steps.text: You search the chest but find nothing.

obtaining-the-pebble-searching-glarial-s.text: If the player does not have Glarial's urn:

steps.text: You find an urn full of ashes in the tomb.

obtaining-the-pebble-searching-glarial-s.text: If the player already has Glarial's urn:

steps.text: You search the tomb but find nothing.

obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-almera-a.speaker: Almera
obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-almera-a.text: Hello adventurer, how's your treasure hunt going?

obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-almera-a.speaker: Almera
obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-almera-a.text: No adventurer stays here this long just to sight see. But your business is yours alone, if you need to use the raft go ahead. But please try not crash it this time!

obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-hudon-af.speaker: Hudon
obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-hudon-af.text: Not you still, why don't you give up?

obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-hudon-af.speaker: Hudon
obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-hudon-af.text: You do understand that anything you find you have to share with me.

obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-hudon-af.speaker: Hudon
obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-hudon-af.text: Because I told you about the treasure.

obtaining-the-pebble-talking-to-hudon-af.player: Well, I wouldn't count on it.

accessing-the-waterfall-dungeon-climbing.text: You try to use the tree to climb down...
...but you slip and fall into the water.

accessing-the-waterfall-dungeon-using-ro.text: You tie the rope to the tree and climb down to the ledge below.

accessing-the-waterfall-dungeon-climbing.text: You climb into the barrel and push off the edge. You are carried down the river.

accessing-the-waterfall-dungeon-opening-.text: If the player is wearing Glarial's amulet:

steps.text: You enter the waterfall.

accessing-the-waterfall-dungeon-opening-.text: If the player is not wearing Glarial's amulet:

steps.text: You try to open the door, but the ledge is suddenly flooded with water...
...you are pushed over the waterfall and into the river.

accessing-the-waterfall-dungeon-talking-.player: Me neither. but I don't give up easily.

accessing-the-waterfall-dungeon-opening-.text: If the player has the key:

steps.text: You use the key to unlock the door.

accessing-the-waterfall-dungeon-opening-.text: If the player does not have the key:

steps.text: The door is locked.

accessing-the-waterfall-dungeon-searchin.text: If the player does not have the key:

steps.text: You find a key in the crate.

accessing-the-waterfall-dungeon-searchin.text: If the player already has the key:

steps.text: You search the crate but find nothing of interest.

accessing-the-waterfall-dungeon-using-ru.text: If the player has already placed that rune on that pillar:

steps.text: You've already put that type of rune on this pillar.

accessing-the-waterfall-dungeon-using-ru.text: If the player used an air rune:

steps.text: You place the rune on the pillar. It disappears in a puff of smoke.

accessing-the-waterfall-dungeon-using-ru.text: If the player used an earth rune:

steps.text: You place the rune on the pillar. It disappears in a puff of smoke.

accessing-the-waterfall-dungeon-using-ru.text: If the player used a water rune:

steps.text: You place the rune on the pillar. It disappears in a puff of smoke.

accessing-the-waterfall-dungeon-using-gl.text: If the player has not yet placed all the runes on the pillars:

steps.text: You go to place the amulet around the neck of the statue. However, water floods into the room as you do...
...you are washed out of the cave and down the river.

accessing-the-waterfall-dungeon-using-gl.text: If the player has placed all the runes:

steps.text: You place the amulet around the neck of the statue. You hear a loud rumble from beneath as the floor rises.

accessing-the-waterfall-dungeon-take-tre.text: You go to take the treasure from the chalice. However, water floods into the room as you do...
...you are washed out of the cave and down the river.

accessing-the-waterfall-dungeon-using-gl.text: You carefully pour the ashes into the chalice and remove Baxtorian's treasure...

post-quest-take-treasure-from-the-chalic.text: The chalice only contains some old ashes.
